tools.name: book_test_drive
tools.description: Book a test drive for an Euler Motors electric vehicle.

vehicle.description: The model of the vehicle to book (e.g., 'HiLoad EV', 'Storm EV T1500')

city.description: City name for the test drive location

tools.name: calculate_emi
tools.description: Calculate the monthly EMI, total interest, and total payable amount for a vehicle based on down payment and tenure.

vehicle.description: The name/model of the vehicle (e.g., 'HiLoad EV', 'Storm EV T1500')

tools.name: compare_vehicles
tools.description: Compare specifications of multiple Euler Motors electric vehicles (e.g., HiLoad EV vs Storm EV T1500).

vehicles.description: List of vehicle names to compare (e.g., ['HiLoad EV', 'Storm EV T1500'])

tools.name: download_brochure
tools.description: Get the brochure download link for a specific Euler Motors electric vehicle.

vehicle.description: The vehicle name to get the brochure for (e.g., 'HiLoad EV', 'Storm EV T1500')

tools.name: find_charging_station
tools.description: Find nearby Euler charging stations and partner charging points in a specified city or along a route.

city.description: City name to search for charging stations (e.g., 'Delhi', 'Bangalore')

tools.name: find_dealer
tools.description: Find nearby Euler Motors dealerships and service centers in a specified city.

city.description: The name of the city to search for dealers (e.g., 'Chennai', 'Agra')

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Get frequently asked questions and answers about Euler Motors vehicles, charging, warranty, service, and financing. For vehicle-specific FAQs, use the vehicle parameter (e.g. hiload, storm, stormlr, turbo).

vehicle.description: Optional: Vehicle to get FAQs for. Use this for model-specific questions (e.g. hiload for HiLoad EV, storm for Storm EV T1500)

category.description: FAQ category to filter by (only applies to general FAQs, not vehicle-specific)

tools.name: get_vehicle_specs
tools.description: Return detailed technical specifications for an Euler Motors vehicle. Use this for payload, range, battery, dimensions, motor, brakes, and features.

vehicle.description: Vehicle to get specs for: hiload = HiLoad EV, storm = Storm EV T1500, stormlr = Storm EV LongRange 200

tools.name: request_callback
tools.description: Submit a callback request for a customer interested in Euler Motors vehicles. Uses the same enquire-now flow as the website contact form.

vehicle_interest.description: Vehicle the customer is interested in, e.g. 'HiLoad EV', 'Storm EV T1500' (optional)

tools.name: search_blog
tools.description: Search Euler Motors blogs and news articles by keyword or get the latest articles.

tools.name: search_vehicle
tools.description: Search and filter Euler Motors electric vehicles based on vehicle type (3-wheeler/4-wheeler) and payload capacity.

vehicleType.description: The category of the vehicle: THREE_WHEELER or FOUR_WHEELER

city.description: The city where the vehicle is required (optional, used for local availability checks)
